questions.prompt: Which subkeys do you want to retire?
questions.help: Only subkeys that are valid and were replaced are offered.
The reason decides how old signatures are read.

options.label: Superseded: a newer subkey replaced them
options.description: Strict verifiers keep signatures dated before the day of the switch. Measured on 2026-11-10 with sqv; gpgv accepts all.

options.label: Compromised: someone else may hold them
options.description: Strict verifiers reject every signature the subkey ever made. Use it only if you must.
